The *Uppannattika* ("Triad on the Arisen") constitutes the eighteenth chapter of the first main division of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the canonical Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Like the other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to investigate the phenomena classified under the *uppannattika* triad from the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*).
